messages:
harper: Seaport cutover prep reminder: dry-run tomorrow 08:30 PT. Need final KMS key ARN, Cross-account role name + trust policy (with ExternalId), S3 bucket for audit logs, egress ACLs, and any DNS caveats by EOD. Tagging @seaport-sre.

seaport-sre: KMS ARN is arn:aws:kms:us-east-2:2233445566:key/seaport-main. Role = RedwoodAccessRole-Seaport. Audit bucket = s3://seaport-redwood-audit. Egress outbound: 10.20.0.0/16 -> 34.56.78.0/24:443 and allow 10.20.2.0/24 -> 8.8.8.8:53 for resolver.

niu: FYI we hit an internal DNS TTL issue in staging; please set internal redwood-api name to 10.20.2.18 with TTL=30 so switchover is fast.

alex: audit logs question: object lock currently OFF? We recommend OFF for retention lifecycle. Seaport, confirm retention days needed.

seaport-sre: object lock is currently OFF. Retention requirement is 180d. We'll add lifecycle rule. Also note: KMS key has pending rotation in 6 days; we'll postpone rotation until after cutover.

harper: can you paste the IAM trust policy we expect on RedwoodAccessRole-Seaport (we'll validate sts:ExternalId)? sample below.

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/redwood-deploy"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"sts:ExternalId": "seaport-ext-789"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

seaport-sre: trust policy present but ExternalId uses seaport-ext-456 per their security team. We'll update and paste final policy.

deploy-bot: dry-run reminder queued for 2026-03-25T15:30:00Z (job dj-9021). Will post run status.

seaport-sre: post-dry-run summary: health checks green, audit upload ok, one transient 502 on /v1/chat during synthetic spike. Recovered on retry. Logs:
```
[2026-03-25T08:32:12Z] ERROR 502 /v1/chat - upstream timeout
[2026-03-25T08:32:13Z] INFO 200 /v1/chat - retry ok
```
Ticket SP-221 opened to adjust upstream timeout.

harper: renewal flag: Seaport at month 9 of 12 trial. Low tolerance for repeated 5xx in cutover window; sales notified.

alex: final asks: paste final KMS ARN, confirm bucket lifecycle rule applied, and post the exact trust policy ARN once updated. We'll hold cutover slot until confirmation.

seaport-sre: will post final confirmations within 3 hours. Leaving thread open for the records. :white_check_mark:
